BiblicalUsage: 1) be or become great, be or become many, be or become much, be or become numerous; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to become many, become numerous, multiply (of people, animals, things); 1a2) to be or grow great; 1b) (Piel) to make large, enlarge, increase, become many; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to make much, make many, have many; 1c1a) to multiply, increase; 1c1b) to make much to do, do much in respect of, transgress greatly; 1c1c) to increase greatly or exceedingly; 1c2) to make great, enlarge, do much; 2) (Qal) to shoot
